description.value: Canyon Alpine Restaurant appears to be a dining establishment in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia, likely associated with the Canyon Alpine Motel based on the Facebook URL. No further details about the restaurant could be confirmed due to the Facebook page being inaccessible.
